name: benji-pays
description: Configure Benji Pays for any invoice source that syncs to supported accounting: multi-gateway AR, Invoice Rover, automatic payments, Pay Now, secure lookup, portals, and embedded workflows.

BENJI_PAYS_API_KEY.title: Benji Pays API key
BENJI_PAYS_API_KEY.description: Organization-scoped merchant API key from the Benji Pays app (Settings → API Keys). Sent as the x-api-key header to authenticate the Benji Pays MCP server.
